additionalFields.description: Additional Azure DevOps fields to set by reference name (fields not exposed as named parameters). Example for Bug severity: { "Microsoft.VSTS.Common.Severity": "1 - Critical" } (accepted values: "1 - Critical", "2 - High", "3 - Medium", "4 - Low"). Multi-line text fields (i.e., System.History, AcceptanceCriteria, etc.) must use HTML format. Do not use CDATA tags.

areaPath.description: The area path for the work item

assignedTo.description: The email or name of the user to assign the work item to

description.description: Work item description in HTML format. Multi-line text fields (i.e., System.History, AcceptanceCriteria, etc.) must use HTML format. Do not use CDATA tags.

iterationPath.description: The iteration path for the work item

organizationId.description: The ID or name of the organization (Default: unknown-organization)

parentId.description: The ID of the parent work item to create a relationship with

priority.description: The priority of the work item

projectId.description: The ID or name of the project (Default: no default project)

tags.description: Tags to add to the work item

title.description: The title of the work item

workItemType.description: The type of work item to create (e.g., "Task", "Bug", "User Story")
